components.name: Canvas selection and alignment
components.description: Eight zoom-compensated single/group resize handles; Shift-corner aspect lock and Shift-axis movement. Blue dashed edge/center guides follow the footer snapping toggle, with Alt bypass. Frame moves carry gesture-start contained objects; frame-only resize preserves content. Cancellation discards previews. Moving a connector detaches endpoints from stationary objects at their visible positions; endpoints attached to objects moving in the same selection stay attached, including frame contents.

components.name: Connected sticky creation
components.description: Blank note 80 world units right preserves size/fill/format without text/link/tags. Collisions excluding frames/arrows shift it down by height plus 40 with 16-unit clearance. Note and attached arrow share one history transaction. New note enters editing and camera fit includes source and new note.

components.name: Connector formatting, labels, and connections
components.description: Straight/default, Elbow, and Curved routes choose axes from object centers and attach to boundary anchors. Width presets 1/2/3/4/6/8/12px; Solid/Dashed/Dotted; independent None/Arrow/Open arrow/Circle/Diamond heads; native line color. Legacy default is solid straight 2px with no start head and arrow end. Selected color stays visible over a translucent blue underlay. White 14px Arial midpoint caption: double-click, Enter, or toolbar T edits; Enter commits, Shift+Enter adds a line, Escape cancels. Below-action details panel drafts label and Start/End selectors, applies atomically, rejects self-connections, and offers keyboard attachment access. Blue-filled endpoint circles mean attached, white means free. Drag within 12 screen pixels of eligible bounds to attach; Alt leaves free. Arrows, pens, frames excluded. One gesture is one undo step; cancellation discards preview. 28 model tests and build passed; desktop/mobile REA checked controls, style, labels, keyboard attachments, history, reload. Native drag remains unverified due to prior CUA URL blocker.

dos: **Do** preserve the quiet grid and open canvas.
**Do** reuse the white floating material for editor control groups.
**Do** reserve blue states for actions, focus, and selection.
**Do** compress peripheral chrome using the observed responsive rules.
**Do** match sticky editing to its note fill and keep canvas gestures free of browser text selection.
narrative.overview:
Boardroom inherits the user's chosen reference whiteboard: an open, quiet grid with floating white toolbars, blue selection, and a generous working area. This document describes the independent React and TypeScript prototype, not any existing commercial service. The reference supplies the visual world; the local Boardroom name distinguishes the implementation.

Objects carry color and meaning while the surrounding controls stay compact and restrained. The desktop and mobile captures show the same canvas grammar, with peripheral controls compressed on narrow screens. Typography and geometry are functional rather than expressive.

rules.name: The Content Color Rule
rules.body: Keep object fill choices separate from blue selection and action states.

rules.name: The Open Center Rule
rules.body: Anchor control groups around the working area and leave the center for objects.

donts: **Don't** add a white inset or border to sticky-note editing.
**Don't** use note-fill colors as interface status semantics.
**Don't** apply rounded chrome geometry to every canvas object.
**Don't** infer service features or compliance claims from visual resemblance.
**Don't** promote the empty-state title or wordmark typography into a general display-font system.
keyCharacteristics: An uninterrupted pale grid behind editable objects.
White floating control groups with soft ambient depth.
Blue tool states, selection outlines, and primary actions.
Pastel note fills kept separate from interface state colors.
Eight-handle blue selections and dashed alignment guides, with tool submenus and sticky palettes anchored beside their originating controls.
